# James Schannep

> > Award-winning author of interactive gamebooks and novels, featuring the Click Your Poison series and traditional fiction works.

James Schannep is an author known for creating immersive interactive fiction through the Click Your Poison gamebook series, as well as traditional novels and screenplays. His work spans multiple genres including zombie apocalypse, mystery, spy thrillers, and superhero adventures, all featuring branching narratives with dozens to hundreds of possible endings.

## Key Topics

- Click Your Poison
- Interactive fiction
- Gamebooks
- Multiple endings
- Choose-your-own-adventure

## Interactive Gamebooks

- [Interactive Books](https://jamesschannep.com/books): Portfolio of interactive gamebooks including INFECTED, MURDERED, SUPERPOWERED, PATHOGENS, MAROONED, SPIED, and HAUNTED.
- [INFECTED](https://jamesschannep.com/books/infected): Interactive zombie apocalypse gamebook with military survival scenarios and multiple branching paths.
- [PATHOGENS](https://jamesschannep.com/books/pathogens): Interactive zombie apocalypse gamebook with 6 playable characters and 100+ endings.
- [HAUNTED](https://jamesschannep.com/books/haunted): Interactive horror gamebook set in a haunted house with 3 storylines and 50+ endings.
- [SPIED](https://jamesschannep.com/books/spied): Interactive spy thriller with CIA secret agent gameplay and puzzle-solving mechanics.
- [MAROONED](https://jamesschannep.com/books/marooned): Interactive pirate adventure set in the Golden Age of Piracy with 50+ endings.
- [MURDERED](https://jamesschannep.com/books/murdered): Interactive mystery gamebook featuring detective gameplay and multiple branching endings.
- [SUPERPOWERED](https://jamesschannep.com/books/superpowered): Interactive superhero gamebook with multiple superpowers set in Mercury City.

## Fiction & Novels

- [Fiction](https://jamesschannep.com/fiction): Portfolio of novels, short stories, and screenplays including Social Vampire and Star Wars reboot.
- [Social Vampire](https://jamesschannep.com/fiction/socialvampire): Novel with literary agent Kesia Lupo and traditional publishing updates.
- [Star Wars Reboot](https://jamesschannep.com/fiction/starwars): Star Wars prequel rewrite screenplay project with detailed creative reimagining.

## Author & Information

- [Who is James?](https://jamesschannep.com/aboutjs/about): Author bio for James Schannep: USAFA graduate, Click Your Poison creator, award-winning novelist.
- [Blog](https://jamesschannep.com/blog): Blog featuring author announcements, publishing journey, and writing career updates.
- [Contact](https://jamesschannep.com/aboutjs/contac): Contact form and literary agent information via Kesia Lupo.

## Reference & Resources

- [HAUNTED: Floor Plan](https://jamesschannep.com/books/haunted/haunted-floor-plan): Interactive floor plan map for HAUNTED book by paranormal architect Andrew Driscoll.
- [INFECTED: The Screenplay](https://jamesschannep.com/books/infected/infected-screenplay): Screenplay adaptation of INFECTED book with draft versions and screenwriting resources.
